senses.definition: To turn something in memory into bytes that can be stored or sent and read back.
distractors: To replace a running component without stopping the system around it.
To split one request into many branches that run at the same time.
To avoid something deliberately and on principle.
A kind of input or output a system works in, such as text, images, audio, or video.
To make something deliberately hard to understand so the plain version stays hidden.
